subject: Vendor identity & VAT evidence for NebulaCorp — PO attributes and collection plan
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nebulacorp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nebulacorp.com
Date: 2026-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor registration requirements and PO attributes - action required

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. Procurement at NebulaCorp is starting the vendor registration for Redwood so we can issue a blanket PO and begin provisioning. To expedite setup with our AP team, please provide the following items and confirm a few capabilities: 

Required evidence and attributes:
- Legal name and remit-to address (exact match to bank documentation)
- EU VAT registration number + PDF certificate (for cross-border VAT handling)
- EORI number (if applicable for goods)
- W-9 or W-8BEN-E (tax classification)
- Bank details (IBAN, BIC, bank letter or voided cheque)
- Company tax ID and country of tax residence
- Preferred billing currency and whether you accept multi-currency invoicing
- Sample invoice PDF that includes our PO number in the invoice header (we enforce PO matching)
- E-invoice/UBL capability (optional) — tell us if you can emit UBL or provide an SFTP endpoint for invoice pickup

PO attributes we will use for matching (you must include these on invoices):
- PO Number (10-digit format we will supply)
- Release/line item codes (we will send release numbers under the blanket PO)
- Cost center and project tag (optional, we pass in the release metadata)

Timing and portal:
- We prefer vendors to register via Coupa. If you cannot register directly, our AP team can accept the onboarding template (attached) plus signed vendor form.

Attachment: Nebula_AP_Onboarding_Template.xlsx (please return completed)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
1) Provide an EU VAT cert PDF and bank letter within 3 business days?
2) Accept PO-based matching on invoice PDF with the PO in the top-right header?
3) Register in Coupa (sandbox credentials requested below)?

If you’d like, copy Marissa (sales) and your AP contact for any billing exceptions.

Best,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Senior Procurement Specialist, NebulaCorp
procurement@nebulacorp.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-17T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor registration requirements and PO attributes - action required

Hi Marta,

Thanks — appreciate the list. We can meet the majority of requirements and Ive looped in Marissa (account lead) and Laura (AP lead) to help with evidence and billing details. Quick plan below, and Ive attached our onboarding packet for your records.

What we will provide within 3 business days:
- Legal name and remit address (matches bank letter)
- EU VAT certificate (PDF) — file: ri_vat_certificate_eu.pdf
- Bank letter (bank_letter.pdf) including IBAN/BIC
- W-9 (US) / W-8BEN-E or local equivalent if required
- Sample invoice with PO in header (attached: sample-invoice-with-po.pdf)

Coupa / portal notes:
- We are able to register in Coupa; however, we may need sandbox credentials to validate the template. If Nebula can provide sandbox vendor registration details that would speed validation.
- Alternatively we can push invoices to an SFTP endpoint or provide UBL if you require machine interchange.

Billing terms / exceptions to flag:
- Standard Redwood terms: monthly invoicing, Net 30.
- We can accommodate a Net 45 for the first two invoices by exception — please confirm in writing if procurement approves.

Action items assigned: 
- Laura will attach tax and bank docs (W-9/W-8, VAT cert, bank letter).
- Marissa will follow up on commercial questions (PO cadence, any pricing contingencies).

Attachments: RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf, sample-invoice-with-po.pdf

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@nebulacorp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nebulacorp.com>, procurement@nebulacorp.com
Date: 2026-05-17T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor registration requirements and PO attributes - action required

Jonas, Marta,

Thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from AP: 
- Nebula will issue a 12-month blanket PO (PO-BL-2026-0098) and subsequent releases. Releases will carry our internal release ID and a cost-center code — invoices must include both for auto-match.
- Preferred invoice currency is EUR for EU entities; we can accept USD for services billed to our US entity (let us know which legal entity will receive payments).
- We enforce invoice PDF matching (PO in top-right) and we also support UBL/Peppol ingestion. If you have UBL output, well provide a schema.

Banking / payment terms:
- To expedite setup we need a bank confirmation letter and IBAN/BIC.
- We can approve Net 45 for the first two invoices as a one-time concession, but standard terms should be Net 30 afterwards. Please confirm acceptance.

Coupa: please register in Coupa (we will assign a vendor code). We are also able to provide a sandbox account for testing. Ive attached our PO specs for your billing team.

Attachment: Nebula_PO_Specs.docx

Oliver Hayes
AP Operations Manager, NebulaCorp
oliver.hayes@nebulacorp.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-17T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor registration requirements and PO attributes - internal evidence plan

Jonas / Marissa,

I pulled together what Finance/AP will provide and the owner for each item:
- W-9 / W-8BEN-E: I will produce and sign — due EOD 2026-05-18.
- EU VAT cert (ri_vat_certificate_eu.pdf): Mateo from tax will confirm status; I expect the cert in 24 hrs.
- Bank letter (bank_letter.pdf): in progress, bank can provide a SWIFT/IBAN confirmation letter — due 2026-05-18.
- Sample invoice (sample-invoice-with-po.pdf): attached; includes Nebula PO placeholder fields and UBL snippet notes.
- Invoice format options: we can emit PDF with PO on top-right or provide UBL 2.1/XML via SFTP.

Operational notes and risks:
- Coupa registration: we will attempt sandbox registration; if Nebula requires vendor provisioning, please provide the vendor code and sandbox link.
- Currency / entity mapping: confirm which legal entity on Nebula PO (EUR->Redwood EU entity; USD->Redwood US entity). If they route EUR payments to Redwood EU, we need EU local VAT treatment on invoices.
- Early payment discount: revenue ops to confirm viability of a 1.5% discount for payment within 10 days — pending Marissa approval.

I'll attach the docs to the Coupa request and share with Procurement once ready.

Laura Bennett
Head of AP, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@nebulacorp.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor registration requirements and PO attributes - confirmation and next steps

Hi Oliver / Marta,

Great — thank you for the clarity. We will proceed as follows: 
1) Redwood will register in Coupa and request sandbox access (please send sandbox invite or vendor code).
2) Laura will upload bank_letter.pdf, W-9/W-8, and ri_vat_certificate_eu.pdf to the portal.
3) We will consume the Blanket PO (PO-BL-2026-0098) and ensure each invoice includes: PO number, release ID, and cost center.
4) Payment terms: we accept the Net 45 concession for the first two invoices; thereafter our standard term will be Net 30. Were also happy to offer a 1.5% early-pay discount if Nebula executes early-pay program (confirm platform/process).

Attachments: RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf (contains sample invoice and UBL notes), sample-invoice-with-po.pdf

Can you please reply with sandbox registration URL or vendor code and preferred legal entity for EUR payments (so we map invoices correctly)? Once we have the sandbox, Marissa will validate the invoice test and Laura will finalize the upload.

Thanks,
Jonas
